hero.title: A Safe Space for Every Woman
hero.subtitle: Netsanet is Ethiopia's AI-powered platform for confidential GBV case reporting, legal guidance, and survivor support — available in your language.

features.title: Built for Safety, Designed for Trust
features.subtitle: Every feature is crafted to empower survivors and the institutions that serve them.

items.title: Confidential Reporting
items.description: Submit cases anonymously or with your identity — your safety comes first, always.

items.title: AI-Powered Triage
items.description: Our intelligent system prioritizes urgent cases so help reaches those who need it most.

items.title: Secure Evidence Locker
items.description: Upload and store photos, audio, and documents in an encrypted, tamper-proof vault.

items.title: Legal Guidance AI
items.description: Get instant, context-aware legal information in Amharic, Tigrinya, Oromifa, and more.

items.title: Real-Time Messaging
items.description: Communicate directly with your assigned case worker through secure, encrypted channels.

items.title: Multi-Institution Network
items.description: Cases are seamlessly referred between MoWSA, EWLA, shelters, and medical facilities.

howItWorks.title: Three Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From reporting to resolution — we walk with you every step of the way.

steps.title: Report
steps.description: Submit your case securely through our guided form. Choose anonymous or identified reporting.

steps.title: Get Matched
steps.description: AI analyzes your case and connects you with the right institution and case worker.

steps.title: Receive Support
steps.description: Track your case, communicate with your worker, and access legal guidance — all in one place.

cta.title: Ready to Take the First Step?
cta.subtitle: Every journey begins with courage. Netsanet is here to support you — confidentially and compassionately.
cta.note: No password needed. We use a secure one-time code sent to your email.

footer.tagline: AI-powered support for women across Ethiopia.

cinematic.missionStatement: Every voice deserves to be heard, protected, and answered.
cinematic.missionDesc: Netsanet is Ethiopia's first AI-powered platform dedicated to gender-based violence survivor support — built for confidential reporting, coordinated institutional response, and real-time legal guidance.
cinematic.missionPoint4: Legal AI guide in your language
cinematic.storiesDesc: Survivors, case workers, and legal officers across Ethiopia share how Netsanet changed how they experience safety and justice.
cinematic.testimonial1_quote: The AI triage cut our response time by 60%. Critical cases now get help within the hour.
cinematic.testimonial2_quote: For the first time I felt truly safe reporting. The anonymous mode gave me courage I didn't know I had.
cinematic.testimonial3_quote: The referral network transformed how we coordinate legal aid across agencies.
